name: symbiosis
description: The pi coding agent works in this editor: each write and edit types itself into the buffer while the model writes it, then the editor follows the result. The status bar shows the pi session the editor follows. ctrl+k a pins the editor, ctrl+k d sends AI!/AI? comments to that session, ctrl+k n lets the next session take over, ctrl+k g goes to the session's herdr pane. The status bar also shows pi's plan as a timeline (done › now › next); ctrl+k v shows the whole plan. ctrl+k w shows what pi changed in the open file in its last turn, as a diff.
author: stevetosak
